o1.biggest_strength: Flawless mathematical reasoning, perfect adherence to the constraints, and incredibly practical, ready-to-use message drafts.
o1.biggest_mistake: Very little to fault. It could perhaps have modeled the long-term 12-month value of a won-back customer slightly more prominently.
